continuity_scope: The Dark Crystal, original 1982 feature-film continuity, using Jim Henson Company official film/profile and authorized release press materials. This is a narrow official synopsis/release pass, not a full viewing, screenplay transcription, or later-world-lore pass.
work_or_witnesses: The Dark Crystal, original feature film (1982)
Jim Henson Company official 1982 film profile
Jim Henson Company official digital/4K release press material
Jim Henson Company archive material on original-film production
coverage_rule: Include every named individual dramatic character directly named in selected official original-film synopses: Jen and Kira. Gelflings, Mystics, Skeksis, the Crystal, shard, prophecy, suns, places, and ritual/cosmology remain terms. Individual Skeksis or Mystics are not added because this witness does not name them.
omissions: All other named characters, individual Skeksis/Mystics, Podlings, creatures, places, props, exact scenes, dialogue, and outcomes are omitted because the selected official materials do not establish them claim by claim.
The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance, novels, comics, manga, games, board-game material, documentaries, deleted scenes, subtitles/dubs, and later lore are separate witnesses.
The Crystal, missing shard, prophecy, group identities, three suns, cosmology, and puppet/animatronic production details remain terms or production context rather than peer character nodes.

The Henson materials characterize a dangerous quest, evil Skeksis, world-threatening darkness, and all-puppet production; no detailed death, body-horror, violence, performer credit, or puppet-performance claim is inferred without a specific original-film locator.
uncertainties: The official synopsis gives no scene or timestamp locator, so this is metadata-only.

Henson materials vary slightly in describing Jen as a surviving/last Gelfling or a member of the Mystics. The shared evidence supports Gelfling identity and quest; no claim resolves any broader group-history discrepancy.

The Jim Henson Company describes the film as entirely performed with puppets/creatures, but no character record attributes a single performer, voice, or puppet mechanism without direct cast/credit evidence.
Age of Resistance is explicitly a prequel set many years before the film and is not used for any film continuity detail.
evidence_basis: Jim Henson Company official film, archive, and authorized-release materials only; no fan wiki, Wikipedia, uninspected screenplay, later lore, or frame reproduction is used.
